name: Lena, Selfless Champion — the fired ability reaches only your creatures with less power than Lena
notes: Memory: project_source_compared_subjects_judged_after_layer_7_2026-10-16. 'Sacrifice Lena: Creatures you control with power less than Lena's power gain indestructible until end of turn': the fire-time power bound was only written in after 'target', so 'with power less than this card's power' stayed a required subtype and nothing gained indestructible. It is now written as 'with power 2 or less' from the fire-time snapshot (Lena 3/3): Elvish Mystic (1) and Grizzly Bears (2) gain it, Hill Giant (3), Lena and the opponent's Llanowar Elves do not.
